fact_text: Companies listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange must report their financial results every three months, and each quarterly income statement shows the quarter alongside the same quarter of the prior year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What You Need to Know Before Investing in a Company | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-23)

fact_text: The income statement is the source of sales, cost and profit figures, while the balance sheet shows a company's assets and liabilities, which together indicate its financial performance and financial health.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'What You Need to Know Before Investing in a Company | How to Money | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-23)
